exercises.title: Filtered, sorted SELECT
exercises.brief: Aggressive-risk Mumbai clients with AUM > ₹50 lakh, richest first.
exercises.solution: SELECT client_id, aum_inr FROM clients WHERE risk_profile='Aggressive' AND city='Mumbai' AND aum_inr > 5000000 ORDER BY aum_inr DESC

exercises.title: HAVING guard
exercises.brief: Churn and count per RM, only RMs with ≥30 clients, worst first.
exercises.solution: SELECT relationship_manager, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(churned),3) AS churn FROM clients GROUP BY relationship_manager HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 ORDER BY churn DESC

exercises.title: JOIN with DISTINCT count
exercises.brief: Per city (clients table): distinct transacting clients + total spend.
hints: LEFT JOIN, spend > 0 filter inside or via CTE
exercises.solution: SELECT c.city, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS transactors, ROUND(SUM(t.amount_inr),0) AS spend FROM clients c LEFT JOIN transactions t ON c.client_id=t.customer_id AND t.amount_inr>0 GROUP BY c.city

exercises.title: Top client per city (window)
exercises.brief: Each city's largest client by AUM using RANK() OVER.
exercises.solution: SELECT city, client_id, aum_inr FROM (SELECT city, client_id, aum_inr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY aum_inr DESC) rnk FROM clients WHERE aum_inr IS NOT NULL) x WHERE rnk=1
